title: Total weight of random subsets
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$ and every real number $\\delta$, the sum over all subsets $J$ of $\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$ of $\\delta^{|J|}(1-\\delta)^{n-|J|}$ is $1$.
